shortdesc.ph: The base interface class that implements Agora real-time communication core functionality.
Call the methods of this class to use all features of the Agora SDK.
The basic interface of the Agora SDK that implements the core functions of real-time communication.

section.p: Agora recommends calling API methods on the same thread to avoid calling from multiple threads. This class was previously named AgoraAudio in earlier versions and was renamed to starting from version 1.0.
provides the main methods that your app can call.
